defs.def: to attach or hold two or more things together using string, rope, etc; to fasten sb/sth with string, rope, etc. （用线、绳等）系，拴，绑，捆，束

ex.s: Comparing Ourselves with Others Can Strengthen Family Ties

Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明如果一场争论得到解决与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少或几乎完全消除。因此与其压抑不如和朋友、家 人或同学把问题提出来可能最终会有更好的结果。

defs.def: to fasten sth to or around sth else 将 … 系在 … 上；束紧；系牢；捆绑

ex.s: Then, with one end of a rope tied to his waist and the other end around the trunk of a tree, Ziyad began ____47____ .
ex.t: 然后，齐亚德把绳子的一端系在腰上，另一端绕在树干上，开始____47____。

ex.s: I tied a rope around his waist to keep him near to our spot.
ex.t: 我在他腰上系了一根绳子让他靠近我们的地方。

defs.def: to make a knot in a piece of string, rope, etc. （在线、绳上）打结，系扣
to be closed or fastened with a knot, etc. 打结系牢；系上
to connect or link sb/sth closely with sb/sth else 连接；联合；使紧密结合
to restrict sb and make them unable to do everything they want to 束缚；约束；限制
to have the same number of points 两个队等
to join notes with a tie 用延音联结线连接（音符）
to attach a boat to a fixed object with a rope （使船只）系泊，停靠
to close sth with a knot; to be closed or fastened with a knot 系紧；捆牢；拴住；扎紧

ex.s: So ___45___ tying him up, I just kept a close eye on him.
ex.t: 所以___45___绑着他，我只是紧紧盯着他。

defs.def: to tie sb's arms and legs tightly so that they cannot move or escape 把某人捆绑起来
to keep sb busy so that they have no time for other things 把 … 缠住；使不能分身

ex.s: That might mean either developing a uniform way to mark videos and images, showing when and who they were made by. or abandoning phone calls altogether and moving towards data-based communications—using apps like Face Time or WhatsApp, which can be tied to your identity.
ex.t: 语音操纵技术可能会逐渐削弱这种信任。

defs.def: to attach an animal to sth with a rope, chain, etc. （用绳索等把动物）拴住，拴到 … 上
to connect or link sth to sth else 把 … 联系起来；使与 … 有关系
to invest money so that it is not easily available for use 占用，搁死（资金）

ex.s: Apparently, the idea of money that's not tied to a specific bank — or a specific country — is appealing to many.
ex.t: 不久以前，货币几乎总是在当地创造和使用，物物交换很常见。

defs.def: to deal with all the remaining details of sth 完成；处理完
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, especially by men, with a knot in front 领带
a piece of string or wire used for fastening or tying sth 绳子；金属丝；线
a strong connection between people or organizations 联系；关系；纽带

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样根据研究人员每天只需听30分钟轻音乐就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑有助于健康的血糖水平，

defs.def: a thing that limits sb's freedom of action 束缚；约束；限制；牵累

ex.s: He raised the kite with a piece of string tied to it.
ex.t: 他用一根系在风筝上的细线把它放上了天。

ex.s: With a rope tied around my waist, I clear rubbish left by tourists.
ex.t: 腰间系着一根绳子，我清理游客留下的垃圾。

ex.s: He enjoyed himself making the assistant bring almost everything in the shop to him before he finally on buying a tie.
ex.t: 他玩得不亦乐乎，让店员把店里几乎所有的东西都拿给他看，最后才决定买一条领带。

ex.s: Does the writer use appropriate linking words and phrases to tie the ideas together?
ex.t: 作者是否使用了恰当的衔接词和短语把观点串联起来？

ex.s: Does the writer use proper linking words to tie the essay together?
ex.t: 作者是否使用了恰当的衔接词把文章串联起来？

defs.def: a situation in a game or competition when two or more players have the same score 平局；得分相同；不分胜负
a sports match, especially a football (soccer) match, that is part of a larger competition （尤指足球）淘汰赛
a curved line written over two notes of the same pitch (= how high or low a note is) to show that they are to be played or sung as one note 延音线；延音连接线
one of the heavy pieces of wood or concrete on which the rails on a railway/railroad track are laid （铁路）枕木，轨枕
